name: JULIA
source:
Kazuya is a college student. During summer vacations he is invited by his classmate Aya to a pension house JULIA for part-time work. The pension is held by Atsushi with his wife. This summer story can be played from both Kazuya and Atsushi point of view.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Kazuya是一名大学生。暑假期间，他受同班同学Aya邀请，前往名为JULIA的民宿打工。民宿由Atsushi与妻子共同经营。玩家可以分别从Kazuya和Atsushi的视角体验这个夏日故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
